plans.note: Sec 21.1 caps both Parties at one month of Fees 'without exception', which conflicts with the Excluded Claims regime in 21.2/21.3 and is far below a meaningful cap — likely a material deviation. Read 21.2-21.4 together for carve-outs already present.

Section 20 contains only a broad Customer-gives indemnity (20.1) and the referenced Section 20.5 IP remedies appear absent; check whether any Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity exists (sec-9.3 cross-references 20.5). Likely missing Vendor indemnity plus an over-broad Customer indemnity.
Sec 12.4 imposes a 24-month worldwide non-compete on Customer — direct breach; note sec-12.3 disclaims such commitments, so flag the contradiction and delete 12.4.
Sec-2.2 (first of the two 2.2s) makes Vendor sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics — deviation; sec-12.3 disclaims exclusivity and supports deletion.
No MFN obligation on Customer appears; sec-12.3 expressly disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment, so likely compliant/absent.
No non-solicit binding Customer located; sec-12.3 confirms no no-hire commitment and preserves general recruitment hiring.

Sec-9.4 gives Customer 30-day convenience termination with refunds and denies Vendor the same right — favourable; but check tension with sec-2.1 take-or-pay 'without reduction or termination rights' (flag under MINCOMMIT, not twice).
Sec-8.2 gives a 30-day opt-out plus a 60-day reminder with deadline extension; sec-8.3 caps uplift at lesser of CPI and 3% — likely compliant at or above preferred.
New York law and exclusive New York County courts with an escalation step — within accepted list and courts rather than foreign arbitration; likely compliant.

Customer free assignment to Affiliates/successors (24.1), Vendor restricted (24.2), and no Vendor rights on Customer change of control (24.4) — likely compliant; sec-13.3 ties licence transfer to Section 24.
Customer owns Customer Data and Deliverables with assignment from Vendor and no joint IP; check sec-15.1 use restrictions and sec-14.3 Vendor Technology carve-out — likely compliant.

Sec-13.1 grants a Customer-only, non-transferable licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion and excludes Affiliates/contractors — material deviation; reconcile with sec-13.2/13.3 which are compliant for paid-up material.
Once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, off-site where practicable, Vendor bears cost absent >5% underpayment — likely compliant; sec-23 records clause may add assurance obligations.
No liquidated damages or penalty payable by Customer found; sec-7.3 bars interest on amounts not due. Check sec-2.1 take-or-pay only as a commitment issue under MINCOMMIT.

Sec-19.2 limits the Deliverable warranty to 15 days with no correction or refund thereafter — likely below fallback duration; sec-19.1/19.3/19.4 provide services warranty and a re-perform/refund remedy.
Standard CGL, WC/EL, E&O USD 2M and cyber USD 5M with certificates and non-limitation language — clause present, verify limits against playbook thresholds.

Sec-2.1 imposes USD 2M/year take-or-pay for three years with no reduction or termination rights — material deviation; note conflict with sec-9.4 convenience termination and sec-12.3 disclaimer of minimum-volume commitments.

Sec-11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion with no export — deviation and directly contradicts sec-11.2/11.3 data return and certified deletion; align by striking 11.1 and adding transition assistance.
